overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: crediting the stamped notices over unstamped copies, the bodies recorded posting date and time, and faint stamps did not rise to a violation.

allegations.summary: Five complaints alleged that Swansea bodies' meeting notices failed to indicate the date and time they were posted, as 940 CMR 29.03(1)(b) requires.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the public bodies complied with the requirement to indicate the date and time of posting.

allegations.summary: On further review, the complainant argued the posting stamps were so faint and faded as to be illegible, so date and time were not conspicuously recorded.
allegations.key_passage: The boards made an effort to comply with the Open Meeting Law's requirements, and we find any faintness in the stamps did not rise to the level of an Open Meeting Law violation.
